nodes.rationale: The paid (non-AGPL) licensing option. Valid for distributed software apps and server-side use; duration 99 years; the licensee may distribute the Swiss Ephemeris in compiled form as part of his software, may (optionally) distribute source (in which case AGPL terms apply to modifications), and may use the SWISS EPHEMERIS / SWISS EPHEMERIS Inside labels. Must not mention the authors (Astrodienst, Alois Treindl, Dieter Koch) without written permission; must not remove copyright notices; must provide a free reference copy on request. Parts downloaded from the Astrodienst GitHub repository (github.com/aloistr/swisseph); payment via the online shop; court of jurisdiction Meilen, Kanton Zuerich. (Pricing in swisseph.doc: CHF 750 first, CHF 400 additional, CHF 1550 unlimited; the 2026 contract sheet lists the unlimited license at CHF 700.)
